# ANTShapesBenchmark

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
ANTShapes is a benchmarking dataset suite introduced for evaluating event-based neuromorphic object classification tasks. It provides a standardized event-stream benchmark that enables reproducible comparison of neuromorphic classifiers within iNEST research.
